messages:
maggie: Heads-up — Sunburst signed the NDA this morning. Legal emailed the countersigned PDF to the partner contact.

samir: nice. can we confirm scope? i remember they only want microbenchmarks + latency traces, no model weights leaving their network.

jonas: correct. partner call clarified: runs in their lab, we get aggregated latency and token counts, no raw inputs/outputs. must redact PII.

natalie: working on acceptance criteria doc. draft items: 99th pct latency < 250ms for 8k seq, throughput >= 1200 tok/s per A100 equiv, deterministic config (quant, batch). any objections?

liz: sounds good. add stability: 72h soak with <1% error rate and automatic fallback to smaller batch if OOM.

sunburst_hw: thanks all — we'll provision two racks next week. can you confirm runbook & access hours? our lab window is 9–5 PT weekdays.

maggie: we can do 3x 4-hour windows: Mon/Tue/Wed mornings. i'll post runbook link when it's ready.

samir: telemetry plan: we send `rt_metrics.jsonl` (aggregated) + perf logs. no payloads. natalie: need explicit consent clause in SOW.

natalie: adding clause now. contracts-bot: new SOW version uploaded (v1.2). please review: https://redwood.internal/contracts/sunburst/sow_v1.2.pdf

jonas: quick checklist for the bench engineers: 1) use pinned model v3.1.2 2) quantization: afq8 3) batch sizes: auto but max 32 4) KV cache warmup steps: 128 5) capture `latency_hist.csv`.

liz: include a short prompt set for quality sanity — 20 prompts that exercise long context and multi-turn. share hashes only, not text.

sunburst_hw: agreed. we'll coordinate on who brings the hardware and who runs scripts. can you confirm the SSH key and a user account?

maggie: yes — create `redwood-runner@sunburst` user, add public key we shared. i'll DM the key fingerprint.

samir: reminder: don't include any debug dumps with text. failure mode: if PII detected by our scrubber, stop run and notify partner.

natalie: i've put the signature block in SOW v1.2. once Sunburst signs, we schedule the first run. target week of 1761238000.

sunburst_hw: signing today. thanks for the quick turnaround. excited to get numbers. :rocket:

maggie: great — closing loop. i'll follow up with the runbook + invite for the kick-off meeting.

jonas: one more — post-run, we'll run the Optimize recommendations and share cost delta estimates (no internal perf logs).

liz: copying this thread into the calendar invite so ops have visibility. :calendar:
